info.name: PassportSahayak AI
info.description: All 56 endpoints across the 8 PassportSahayak AI microservices, called via the API Gateway. Run the requests under '0. Auth' first — they auto-save your token into collection variables so every other request just works. Every request has a saved 'Example' response attached (click the request, then the small clock/example icon, or expand it in the left sidebar) so you can see real sample data without even sending it.
